provenance.sourceName: EPCOS AG (TDK group) - Ferrites and Accessories - Data Book 2013 (chapter General - Definitions, section 8)
provenance.verificationMethod: Chapter 'General - Definitions', section 8 'General mechanical, thermal, electrical and magnetic properties of ferrites', printed page 136 (PDF page 137). Source scope: EPCOS/TDK SIFERRIT ferrites (data book covers both MnZn and NiZn grades, e.g. K1/K10 NiZn and N/T-series MnZn). Heading: 'Typical figures for the mechanical and thermal properties of ferrites'. Suggested records (TDK-Electronics/EPCOS-line grades):. As printed: Thermal conductivity approx. 4 ... 7·10^-3 J/(mm·s·K) -> 4-7 W/(m·K); Specific heat approx. 0.7 J/(g·K) -> 700 J/(kg·K). Note: Vendor-authored PDF (Author metadata 'EPCOS AG', title 'Ferrites and Accessories - Data Book 2013') hosted by distributor components.ru; TDK's own epcos.com/ferrites_databook link now 404s. Same table also in the older EPCOS ferrite catalog copy at https://www.thierry-lequeu.fr/data/FER-SIEM.pdf ('approx. 4 ... 7·10-3 J/mm·s·K', 'approx. 0,7 J/g·K'). Table is generic to 'ferrites' (not split MnZn/NiZn); values are 'approx.'. Existing TDK PC47/PC95 records carry 4-7 W/mK (matches this table) but 700-800 J/kgK (only 700 is in this table). Applies equally as a TDK-wide statement; the TDK-Japan summary below gives different numbers for the Japan-line grades.
